direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale is pretty good, as it helps set the climate and conflict of the situation; The microscale is good, and it is important in getting these characters to open up about the traumas of their experiences being held captive and why this is important, even if it eventually makes them carry out the same torture they experienced; The storytelling is good, as it helps build the conflict and its importance, acting as a boiling pot as more people aggregate on this trip until it eventually explodes at the end; It builds tension very well, as it amplifies the importance of the situation and the characters' trauma and how much they want to find out the truth

cast.comments: The cast as a whole works together well to help show their shared trauma of the situation and why finding out the truth matters so much to them; the movie is a constant boiling point that continues to grow as tensions rise as characters start to open up more about why this is important, and all the actors in the cast work well together to make this happen

story.comments: The concept is good, as this journey to search for the truth reveals the current situation in Iran and how their shared trauma makes them hypocritically torture someone who hurt them; The plot structure is linear and acts as a boiling pot, exploding at the end to show the truth; The character writing is good, as it shows the trauma these characters experienced and how, in their quest for vengeance, they hypocritically become the same as the people who hurt them

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is pretty strong; The humor is good, as everyone's expressions make this movie play like a black comedy when it is very serious; The symbolism is strong and twofold, as it shows the state of Iran while also showing the hypocrisy these characters commit as they try to overcome the trauma they endured; The foreshadowing is strong and helps with building the tension and lifting the lid of this boiling story

cinematography.comments: It is shot very well, showing the perspectives of the characters and what they are going through; The tracking and following of the car scene in the desert was very well executed, as it helps emphasize the characters' arguments and shows how important this task is to them, with the length and lack of cuts in the tracking providing emphasis and tension

editing.comments: It is used well to help build tension and put together scenes; A testament to the editing is actually when they do none at all in the car scene in the desert, as it feels like a single take as they track the characters arguing through what they have gone through and why this task is so important to them

sound.comments: It is used well in the ending to show the trauma and the feelings the characters experience; It is decent for the most part

review.climax: Climax is the final confrontation between the characters and their own trauma as this boiling pot finally has its lid taken off
review.tone: The tone very much feels like a black comedy with profound messages about trauma and the current state of Iran
review.overall: Overall, Jafar Panahi creates a pressure-cooker film that builds tension as characters reveal their trauma and pursuit of truth, even if they hypocritically mirror their own torturer; While veiled as a black comedy, the movie's deeper themes explore the current state of Iran and the lasting scars of those living under its regime
